title: Transmission Channel Analysis in Dynamic Models
abstract: arXiv:2405.18987v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a framework for analysing transmission channels in a large class of dynamic models. Our method, labelled Transmission Channel Analysis (TCA), decomposes the total effects captured by impulse response functions into the effects flowing through transmission channels, thereby providing a quantitative assessment of the strength of various well-defined channels. This decomposition requires no identification assumptions beyond those needed to identify the structural shock whose effects the researcher wants to decompose. We provide algorithms to compute the effect through any transmission channel and prove that, for structural vector autoregressive models, impulse response functions are sufficient statistics for doing so. Applications to policy shocks in a variety of popular macroeconomic models demonstrate the empirical relevance of TCA for policy evaluation.

translated_title: 动态模型中的传导渠道分析
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于分析一大类动态模型中传导渠道的框架。我们的方法被称为传导渠道分析（TCA），它将脉冲响应函数所捕捉的总效应分解为通过各个传导渠道流动的效应，从而对各种定义明确的渠道强度提供定量评估。这一分解除了识别研究者想要分解其效应的结构性冲击所需的假设之外，不需要任何额外的识别假设。我们提供了计算通过任意传导渠道的效应的算法，并证明对于结构向量自回归模型而言，脉冲响应函数是完成该计算的充分统计量。在多种流行的宏观经济模型中对政策冲击的应用表明，TCA在政策评估中具有重要的实证价值。
tldr: 提出传导渠道分析（TCA）框架，将脉冲响应函数捕捉的总效应分解为通过各传导渠道的效应，实现对渠道强度的定量评估，且无需额外的识别假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Transmission Channel Analysis (TCA), a framework that decomposes the total effects captured by impulse response functions into effects flowing through transmission channels, enabling quantitative assessment of channel strength without requiring additional identification assumptions.
